data.name: Hilyah
data.gender_notes: Hilyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hilyah is an Arabic name for girls that means adornment, embellishment. It refers to the beauty of a person or thing. The name Hilyah carries the meaning “Adornment, embellishment” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Hilyah usually hope their child will grow to embody adornment, embellishment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: When you name your daughter Hilyah, you are expressing your hope that she will be a source of adornment and embellishment in the world, that she will add beauty and grace to everything she touches.
data.etymology: Hilyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Adornment, embellishment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hilyah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: حلیة

in_urdu.name: حلیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: حلیہ ایک عربي لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور زینت اور نعمت، اور اسے قرآن پاک میں سورہ الفرقان میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، اور اسے مسلم ثقافت میں مؤمنوں کے اندرونی اور بیرونی جمال کی وضاحت کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हिल्या

data.cultural_impact: Hilyah is a name that emphasizes the importance of beauty, especially in the Islamic context where physical appearance is intertwined with moral character. The name "Hilyah" encourages one to strive for inner and outer beauty and to appreciate the artistry and richness of the Islamic culture. The love for beauty is also an essential aspect of Sufism, the mystical branch of Islam, where the path to God is likened to a beautiful garden filled with the fragrance of spiritual devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Hilyah lies in its reference to the inner and outer beauty that comes from a close connection with God. In Islamic tradition, the heart represents the inner self and serves as a lens through which one perceives the world. A beautiful heart is one that is filled with God's love and compassion. Additionally, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) spoke of the 'adornment of the faith' which includes religious practices, good manners, and virtues. By embodying this adornment through living a virtuous life, one enhances not only their own spiritual development but also importantly, serves as an inspiration to others. Overall, Hilyah reflects the idea that inner and outer beauty are interconnected, and that striving for spiritual growth and physical self-care are essential aspects of living an Islamic life.
